svg.title: How an answer comes to be
svg.desc: Before use, npm run index reads each CV PDF, splits its text into section chunks and has Gemini extract one profile; the field check keeps only the fields found in the CV's text, each with its page, and writes the profile and chunks to data/index. Each chunk is then embedded and stored in Pinecone. At question time the chat screen posts the question to /api/ask. The answer model reads no CV text: it calls the exact tools (find, count and get candidates) over the in-memory index, or search_cv_text, which embeds the query and fuses Pinecone's vector matches with BM25 over the same chunks. The model ends with a present call; the answer check refuses any candidate no tool returned, corrects any page no tool cited, and builds the view and its opening sentence from the tool results before the answer streams back to the chat screen. indexing a CV: data/cvs → Gemini → Field check → data/index → Gemini embedding → Pinecone. a question: Chat screen → POST /api/ask → Gemini → Exact tools, search_cv_text → data/index. a presentation naming a candidate no tool returned: Gemini → Answer check, refused at Answer check. the checked answer: Gemini → Answer check → Chat screen.
